title: Advice to get big for short/narrow lifters
summary: NH gives advice to short and narrow-framed lifters ('manlets/framelets') on building and looking big. The captions are unusable machine gibberish, so only the title and description are reliable.
claims: Short and narrow-framed lifters can still build a big-looking physique with the right strategy
Being short or narrow is a fact to accept, not a weakness
